title: SafeHer — More than the shortest way home

scenes.heading: The shortest route isn't the whole story
scenes.narration: A night out should end with memories, not a mental checklist of dark streets and places to ask for help. That's why we built SafeHer. Because getting home is about more than finding the shortest route.

scenes.heading: Priya's walk · Indiranagar · 9:30 PM
scenes.narration: Meet Priya. She's leaving a friend's birthday at Toit, in Bengaluru, at nine thirty, and walking to her P G near Bob's Bar. SafeHer compares walking alternatives using lighting, transit, support places, historical incidents, and community reports.

scenes.heading: The same street. A different time.
scenes.narration: The context changes with her departure time. Satellite night lights, mapped lighting, and opening hours inform the picture. Missing evidence stays visible. A score is context, not a promise that a street is safe.

scenes.heading: Inspectable evidence, not a black-box verdict
scenes.narration: Priya can inspect the score, its weakest stretches, and the evidence behind it. SafeHer computes the numbers. Gemini two point five Flash on Vertex A I explains the trade-offs in English or Hindi. Those explanations are checked against the route's actual facts.

scenes.heading: Plan B · Know where help may be available
scenes.narration: And if she needs to stop? Plan B checks walking-network access to places that may be open along her route. It highlights gaps, instead of assuming that a nearby dot means reachable help.

scenes.heading: HerSide · A real decision before leaving
scenes.narration: Before leaving, Priya asks HerSide: Is the extra walking time worth it for better lighting and fewer weak stretches? She attaches this trip, so the question has real context. Google's Agent Development Kit coordinates Gemini-powered specialists and validated tools. The answer compares computed route evidence, not an invented safety verdict. Priya stays in control of the decision.

scenes.heading: Place context · Grounded with Google Maps
scenes.narration: For place-specific questions, HerSide can use Google Maps grounding and show its sources. It focuses on practical context, such as opening hours and available support, with a topic guard that keeps the assistant focused on walking safety.

scenes.heading: Share by choice. Stop by choice.
scenes.narration: Priya shares a private location link with someone she trusts. This demo uses simulated G P S. Sharing is opt-in and foreground-only, stores only the latest point, and expires after two hours. Stop sharing revokes access.

scenes.heading: Urgent help never waits for AI
scenes.narration: Urgent help never waits for A I. One one two opens the phone dialler. No automatic emergency dispatch.

scenes.heading: SafeHer · Better-informed walks. Your decision.
scenes.narration: Delhi and Bengaluru. Open geospatial data, Google Maps, and Gemini on Vertex A I. SafeHer doesn't promise safety. It makes the evidence clearer, so women can make better-informed choices about their walk home.
